EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL
Government Notifications
UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
Order under Section 25A

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978 I, Dissanayake MudiyanselageSumanaweera Banda Dissanayake, the Minister of Higher Education, having obtained a report under section 70 C of theaforesaid Act, in respect of the Horizon College of Business and Technology (Pvt) Limited, a Company incorporated inSri Lanka under the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007 and bearing registration number PV 62877, do by this Order and subject tothe conditions specified in the Schedule hereto, recognize the Horizon College of Business and Technology (Pvt) Limited asa Degree Awarding Institute for the purpose of developing Higher Education therein, leading to the award of the Degreesspecified in Column I of the Schedule hereto, of which the abbreviations are set out in the corresponding entries respectivelyin Column II of the Schedule hereto.
SCHEDULE
1. Horizon College of Business and Technology (Pvt) Limited (hereinafter referred to as the “Institute”) shall before the
expiry of two months from the date of granting the degree awarding status, submit its Articles of Association dulyamended as set out below to the Specified Authority:-
(a) to specify higher education as an object in the Articles of Association;(b) to undertake to inform the specified Authority of a voluntary or involuntary winding up of the company prior to
such winding up.
2. The Institute shall inform the Specified Authority of any changes made in any document submitted to the Specified
Authority for recognition of degree awarding status.
3. The Institute shall before the expiry of three months from the date of granting the degree awarding status, submit the
following details to the Specified Authority:-
(i) proof of appointment of qualified academic and non academic staff;(ii) proof of the availability of the students prospectus, text books and learning material.

In this Order “the Specified Authority” means the Secretary to the Ministry of the Minister assigned the subjectof Higher Education.
